visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a Chiikawa brand bath ball packet in a brightly lit indoor hallway. The packet is light blue and white with cartoon characters. The hand moves slightly to show the packaging details while a young girl stands in the background near a doorway. (2) The camera pans to show a young girl with short dark hair wearing a white t-shirt. The person holding the packet points to a specific character (Hachiware) on the front of the bag as they converse. (3) The scene shifts slightly to show a young boy, shirtless, looking curiously at the camera and the bath ball packet. The lighting remains bright and natural for an indoor setting. (4) The scene changes to a white bathroom. The orange, spherical bath ball is removed from its packaging over a white bathtub partially filled with water. The person's hand is visible holding the ball. (5) The orange bath ball is dropped into the clear water. It immediately begins to fizz vigorously, releasing a bright yellow-orange dye that clouds the water. Two small hands reach toward the water. (6) The person flips the packaging over to show the back, pointing at Japanese text and numbers. A diagram suggests a calculation based on the product code to predict the interior toy. (7) A small white and blue toy character (Hachiware) is shown floating in the yellow-dyed water on the edge of the tub. The toy is tiny, plastic, and wet.
